items.briefing:
Many Australian businesses are rushing to adopt AI tools without putting proper rules or oversight in place first, creating new risks around data handling and decision-making. At the same time, AI is increasingly being used both to detect and to carry out mortgage fraud, meaning staff should be cautious about unusual requests related to financial or identity information.

A reminder that strong network practices — like keeping different systems separated — can significantly reduce your organisation's exposure if something goes wrong. **Practical tip:** Before using any new AI tool at work, check with your manager or IT team that it has been approved for use with organisational data.

featured.title: AI is the new battleground in mortgage fraud detection
featured.quote: AI-generated fake payslips and deepfakes are enabling mortgage fraud at scale across Australian lenders.
